column4: So today my girlfirend broke up with me, its makes me so sad
column5: I can feel the sadness in your words today. This emotion, though painful, is a natural part of being human and often signals something important - perhaps a loss, disappointment, or unmet need. Allow yourself to experience this feeling without rushing to fix it or push it away. Sadness often needs gentle acknowledgment and expression, whether through tears, creative outlets, or sharing with someone who cares. Your feelings matter and deserve attention. Consider what this sadness might be telling you about what you value or need. Remember that emotions are temporary visitors, and while this feeling is real, it won't last forever. Be especially kind to yourself during this vulnerable time.
